fields.default: How to keep your chain alive through winter

fields.name: body
fields.label: Text
fields.default:
Road salt eats chains. Every March we replace dozens that would have lasted two more years with ten minutes of care a week. This is what we tell everyone who rides through the cold months.

After a wet ride

Wipe the chain with a dry rag while you turn the pedals backwards. You are not cleaning it, only getting the salty water off before it dries.

Once a week

  • Degrease the chain and let it dry for five minutes.
  • Put one drop of wet lube on each link, not a stripe along the whole chain.
  • Wipe off the extra. Lube belongs inside the rollers, not on the outside.

When to come and see us

If the chain skips under load or looks orange in the morning, bring the bike in. A chain check takes two minutes and costs nothing. A new chain is 29 euros fitted. A new chain, cassette and chainrings is closer to 180.
